domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups of a PR in flight). Shape per ruling B on #33718 (record 6891082225): one checklist card per reviewed PR; later reviews of PR #33766 append here. Dedupe: no open issue names PR #33766 apart from its card #33717.

## review follow-ups of PR #33766 (card #33717, weekly governed-merges audit)

Records: 6892622399, 6892950815, 6893253118, 6893533098 (PASS on head `0f23dcd2`, nits only). Every item fails safe (an extra card or an unread row), none lets a BREACH or an unread week end green with no card.

- [ ] N1 the single-branch mirror holds no PR head commits, so an arm landing whose record was carried over a regeneration hop always reads NOT MEASURED on the runner.
- [x] N4 a governed commit with no PR number in its subject (`pr: null`) reads clean (the audit script's own reading).
- [x] N5 `scripts/check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs` header still says four patrols.
- [ ] N7 a NOT MEASURED row the runner can never read is only answered by leaving the window.
- [x] N8 card body size is not bounded in characters; over the API limit the update is refused weekly until closed; the carried count includes rows past the 100 cap.
- [x] N9 the body is updated before the comment (a failed comment loses the "new" announcement); the carried mark says "not in this run's reading" even for a row read in another state.
- [x] N10 "closed means the maintainer ruled" is asserted, not read (a seat close, a closing keyword or `stale.yml` counts; the label is not stale-exempt).
- [x] N12 only one closed card is read: a newer closed card holding only NOT MEASURED rows, or a reopen and re-close, hides an older ruling (the row is re-announced).
- [x] N13 the unkeyed count misses a reworded heading or a row moved above it.
- [x] N14/N16/N17 section-reader edges: a stderr line starting with a read heading, a maintainer line starting with the footer text, a hand-deleted footer (last section swallows to the end).
- [x] N15 the ruling horizon borrows `AUDIT_HISTORY_DAYS` (the clone-depth constant) without updating its comment; "a reused key is never hidden" overstates.
- [x] N18 the card body says "Rows on the newest closed card count as ruled" without the day bound.

`.github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml` (Tier H); `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`. Waits for PR #33766.
